stem: Why was this congressional structure created by the framers of the Constitution?

options.label: A
options.text: To follow the plan outlined in the Articles of Confederation

options.label: B
options.text: To reach a compromise between large and small states

options.label: C
options.text: To reach a compromise between slave states and non-slave states

options.label: D
options.text: To implement the outcome of a popular vote
